sentences: On Saturday evening, Jiwoo was cooking dinner with her younger brother when suddenly all the lights in the apartment **went out**.
She looked out the window and saw that the whole street was dark, so the strong wind must have **damaged** a **power line** nearby.
Her brother wanted to use his phone as a **flashlight**, but Jiwoo told him to keep the **battery** for emergencies and found some old **candles** instead.
They **placed** the candles on the kitchen table so that they could see each other's faces, and then they **dug out** a board game they had not played for years.
en.answer: 토요일 저녁, 지우가 남동생과 함께 저녁을 만들고 있는데 갑자기 아파트의 불이 모두 꺼졌다.

sentences: An einem kalten Sonntag im November klopfte mein **Mitbewohner** Paul an meine Tür, weil mein Fenster schon wieder **gekippt** war.
Er erklärte mir, dass ein gekipptes Fenster kaum frische Luft bringt, während die **Heizung** darunter die ganze Zeit gegen die **Kälte** arbeitet.
Viel besser ist das sogenannte **Stoßlüften**: Man öffnet mehrmals am Tag alle Fenster weit und lässt für einige Minuten kalte Luft hereinströmen.
Weil wir unsere nasse Wäsche im Flur trocknen, ist die **Luftfeuchtigkeit** hoch, und in den Ecken kann sich leicht **Schimmel** bilden.
de.answer: 11월의 어느 추운 일요일, 제 창문이 또 젖혀 열려 있어서 룸메이트 파울이 제 방문을 두드렸습니다.
